newsitem.title: CHINA: Japan's Kirin invests in bio-pharmaceutical JV.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Kirin invests in bio-pharmaceutical JV.

text.p: Japanese Kirin Brewery Co Ltd and China's State Science and Technology Commission (SSTC) have created a $29.5 million bio-pharmaceutical joint venture in Shanghai to produce medicines, a commission official said on Monday.

Kirin has provided 70 percent of the total investment in the Kirin Kunpeng Bio-Pharmaceutical Co Ltd, with the remaining capital coming from the Shanghai Kunpeng Investment and Development Co Ltd, a firm mainly owned by SSTC, the official said.
The plant will be constructed in the Shanghai Zhangjiang Hi-technology park in the Pudong development zone to the east of the city centre.
The official gave no details of production plans.
